```renyi
public function quote(parcel: Parcel) returns Quote
  purpose: Price and delivery time for one parcel; the host calls this at every checkout.
  example: quote(Parcel(weight_grams: 500, destination: Domestic, order_total: 60.00))
    is Quote(cost: 0, business_days: 2, free_shipping: true)
  example: quote(Parcel(weight_grams: 2500, destination: Europe, order_total: 20.00))
    is Quote(cost: 14.50, business_days: 5, free_shipping: false)

  let free_shipping be parcel.destination is Domestic and parcel.order_total is at least free_shipping_threshold

  if free_shipping then
    return Quote(cost: 0, business_days: delivery_days(parcel.destination), free_shipping: true)
  otherwise
    let cost be base_cost(parcel.destination) + (weight_steps(parcel.weight_grams) * 2.00)
    return Quote(cost: cost, business_days: delivery_days(parcel.destination), free_shipping: false)
  end
end
```

```renyi
public function quote(parcel: Parcel) returns Quote
  purpose: Price and delivery time for one parcel; the host calls this at every checkout.
  example: quote(Parcel(weight_grams: 500, destination: Domestic, order_total: 60.00))
    is Quote(cost: 0, business_days: 2, free_shipping: true)
  example: quote(Parcel(weight_grams: 2500, destination: Europe, order_total: 20.00))
    is Quote(cost: 14.50, business_days: 5, free_shipping: false)

  let shipping_cost be base_cost(destination: parcel.destination)
  let extra_steps be weight_steps(parcel.weight_grams)
  set shipping_cost to shipping_cost + (extra_steps.to_decimal() * 1.50)

  let free_shipping be parcel.destination is Domestic and parcel.order_total is at least free_shipping_threshold
  if free_shipping then
    return Quote(cost: 0, business_days: delivery_days(destination: parcel.destination), free_shipping: true)
  otherwise
    return Quote(cost: shipping_cost, business_days: delivery_days(destination: parcel.destination), free_shipping: false)
  end
end
```
